title: Bus with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- road shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='42' ry='6' fill='#2a3a5a'/>
  <!-- bus body -->
  <rect x='10' y='28' width='80' height='46' rx='8' fill='#f5c518'/>
  <!-- roof stripe -->
  <rect x='10' y='28' width='80' height='10' rx='8' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <!-- window band -->
  <rect x='16' y='42' width='68' height='18' rx='4' fill='#5fd0e8'/>
  <!-- window divider posts -->
  <rect x='38' y='42' width='3' height='18' fill='#f5c518'/>
  <rect x='60' y='42' width='3' height='18' fill='#f5c518'/>
  <!-- windshield -->
  <rect x='14' y='44' width='20' height='14' rx='3' fill='#a8ecf7'/>
  <!-- destination sign -->
  <rect x='24' y='32' width='26' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <!-- headlight eyes -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='70' r='5' fill='#fff6c8'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='70' r='5' fill='#fff6c8'/>
  <!-- smiley on door panel / lower body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='9' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='63' r='1.8' fill='#5a2a00'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='63' r='1.8' fill='#5a2a00'/>
  <path d='M44 68 Q50 74 56 68' stroke='#5a2a00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bumpers -->
  <rect x='8' y='74' width='84' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e8833a'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='80' r='8' fill='#3b4a6b'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='80' r='3.5' fill='#9fb4d8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='80' r='8' fill='#3b4a6b'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='80' r='3.5' fill='#9fb4d8'/>
</svg>
